reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that queries API balance and calculates estimated session costs, displaying both in the composer statistics line with refresh and pricing configuration support.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框统计栏中显示 API 余额和基于 token 用量估算的本次会话费用，并支持刷新与自定义网关。
summaries.en: Displays the DeepSeek API balance and an estimated per-session cost from token usage in the DeepSeek Harness composer statistics line, with refresh and custom gateway support.

capabilities: Reads the configured DeepSeek API credential at request time
Calls a configurable balance endpoint over HTTP
Displays account balance and estimated per-session costs in the composer statistics area
Calculates cost estimates from token usage and configured pricing
